TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_BROKEN_GOURD_RECOVERY.why: When you fail a Dexterity saving throw, expend Martial Focus to reroll it (once until a rest = once a fight); the new result counts (combat/ext/d20_rewrite_rules.py). The 10-foot move on a new success is a GM line.

tianxia.path.body_refining.feature.indom.why: When you fail a saving throw, spend 3 Stamina to reroll it, once per round, no action (combat/ext/d20_rewrite_rules.py). AUTO1 2026-10-04: those four printed procedure lines are the table's own rules (combat/ext/d20_rewrite_rules.py rolls=('save',), limit='round'), so they are no longer left as GM lines.
covers: You may use Indomitable Body once per round.
You must use the new result.
A die cannot be rerolled more than once.

tianxia.subpath.body.phoenix_rebirth_bod.why: Reaction, 2 Rebirth Embers: reroll a failed Strength, Dexterity or Constitution save (combat/ext/d20_rewrite_rules.py). The 5-foot move on a new success is a GM line.

tianxia.talent.equipment.ancestral_battl.why: Once per long rest (a fight), reroll a failed saving throw (combat/ext/d20_rewrite_rules.py).

tianxia.talent.chains.chain_breaker_s_le.why: Once per short rest (a fight), reroll a failed check or save made to escape a grip (combat/ext/d20_rewrite_rules.py).

tianxia.subpath.qi.devil_heart_second_fu.why: Reaction, 2 Devil Qi, once a round: reroll a failed saving throw and add Proficiency Bonus to the new roll; a success backlashes 3d8 Psychic on a creature source within 120 feet that you see (combat/ext/d20_rewrite_rules.py).

tianxia.subpath.qi.bloodline_cultivator..why: Memory Before Thought: Reaction, 2 Resonance, once a round: reroll a failed save or check and add Proficiency Bonus (combat/ext/d20_rewrite_rules.py).

tianxia.tradition.spirit.candlemaker.fea.why: Reaction, 2 Resonance: you or an ally within 30 feet rerolls a failed Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma save (combat/ext/d20_rewrite_rules.py).

tianxia.talent.stars.star_soul_guidance.why: Reaction, 3 CP: a creature within 30 feet that fails a save against being Charmed, Frightened, possessed or moved rerolls it; once a fight for each creature. tianxia.talent.thread.stitch_the_broken_.why: Reaction, 3 CP: you reroll a failed Concentration save (once a fight); the +Proficiency Bonus counts only on a typed save (combat/ext/d20_rewrite_rules.py). Creatures connected to your Thread Lines are not tracked.

tianxia.subpath.body.drunken_fist.featur.why: Reaction, 2 Stamina, once a round: an attack roll that hits you is rerolled with Disadvantage (combat/ext/d20_rewrite_rules.py).

TAL_FATE_REWRITE_THE_DISASTER.why: Reaction, 12 CP, once a fight: a creature within 60 feet rolls a d20; replace it with a natural 20 (an ally) or a natural 1 (a foe, which may make a Charisma save to keep its roll); the table offers it only when the replacement turns the outcome in your side's favour (combat/ext/d20_rewrite_fate.py). tianxia.tradition.spirit.fate_reader.fea.why: Invoke the Omen: Reaction, 1 Resonance: replace a d20 of a creature you see within 60 feet with your prepared Omen die (combat/ext/d20_rewrite_fate.py). Replaces the earlier generic row.
